evidence: Modifies shared argument parser infrastructure in src/common/args.{cpp,h} and startup validation across src/init.cpp.
rationale: Fixes hazardous and counterintuitive configuration behaviors where negating options set them to "0", causing crashes, unexpected connections, or unintended execution. As noted in the description, options like -nolimitclustercount caused an assertion crash, -notorcontrol connected to 0.0.0.0:9051, -norpcpassword set the password to "0", and notify flags attempted to run a binary named "0".
